recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Revisit only if the work group wants a broader redesign of support navigation or the external Implementer Support page, not as a core-spec fix for FHIR-8195.
issue_request: FHIR-8195 was a Published FHIR-core/QI-Core change request, resolved Not Persuasive with Modification, asking for guidance on how common clinical data should be represented in FHIR. The accepted modification was to avoid maintaining a dynamic answer list in the specification and instead replace the old Support/Stack Overflow section with a support link leading to community guidance and examples.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git-svn commit 2390c6129a3e9541dc64e4e18c2ef3fbd6e71d01, '#8195 - remove support.html', matching the Jira comment for SVN revision 6814. That commit deleted source/support.html and changed local support links to the FHIR Support Page; follow-up history added Support Links to the developer/general overview surfaces, created the Implementation Support module, and later migrated wiki links to Confluence/community destinations.
additional_context: Current build-scope source has no source/support.html. source/hierarchy.xml includes the Implementation Support module, source/implsupport-module.html has a Getting Help section listing Zulip, the FHIR Community Forum, Stack Overflow, and HL7 FHIR documentation, and source/overview.html plus source/overview-dev.html point readers to Support Links/Implementer Support. The current architect overview was introduced after the 2015 application and is not misleading without a duplicate support link.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current source already routes support questions to maintained support surfaces and does not attempt to maintain the broad clinical-data answer list that the work group rejected.

evidence_items.learned: The final decision was to avoid maintaining a dynamic answer list in core and instead route users to support channels with examples and guidance.
